																			local SoundPart = RagdollPallet and RagdollPallet:FindFirstChild("SoundPart")
																			local n870 = 0

																			if t248.Root and v7093 and v7093.Position.Y < 2000 then
																				local Position = v7093.Position

																						for _, v in t248.Char:GetChildren() do

																								v.CanCollide = false
																							end
																						end
																					end
																				end)

																				while true do
																					if n870 < 50 and v7094 and v7094:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead and v7093.Position.Y < 2000 then
																						if not workspace:FindFirstChild(p1118.Name) or v7095:FindFirstChild("PartOwner") ~= nil and (not v7095:FindFirstChild("PartOwner") or v7095.PartOwner.Value == LocalPlayer.Name) then
																							break
																						end

																						t248.Root.CFrame = v7093.CFrame + (v7093.Position - Position) * LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 100
																						t248.Root.Velocity = t247.VectorZero
																						task.spawn(t251.SNO, v7093)

																						if SoundPart then
																							firetouchinterest(SoundPart, v7093, 0)
																						end

																						task.wait()

																						if not v7095 or not v7095:FindFirstChild("PartOwner") or v7095.PartOwner.Value ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
																							n870 += 1

																							continue
																						end

																						task.spawn(t251.SNO, v7093)
																						v7094:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
																						task.wait()
																						t249.DestroyLineEvent:FireServer(v7093)
																						t248.Root.CFrame = CFrame_
																						t248.Root.Velocity = t247.VectorZero
																						task.wait()

																						break
																					end

																					break
																				end

																					task.spawn(t251.SNO, v7093)
																					v7094:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
																					task.wait()
																					t249.DestroyLineEvent:FireServer(v7093)
																					t248.Root.CFrame = CFrame_
																					t248.Root.Velocity = t247.VectorZero
																					task.wait()
																				end
																			end

																						local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

																							t248.Char,
																							workspace.Terrain
																						}
																						raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

																						local hit = workspace:Raycast(Position, LookVector * 1000, raycastParams) or workspace:Raycast(Position, (LookVector - Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)).Unit * 1000, raycastParams) or workspace:Raycast(Position, (LookVector + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)).Unit * 1000, raycastParams)

																						if not hit then
																							return nil
																						end

																						local Instance_ = hit.Instance
																						local Parent = Instance_.Parent

																						if Parent and Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
																							if Parent.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
																								return nil
																							end
																						else
																							Parent = Instance_:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")

																							if not Parent or not Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or Parent.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
																								return nil
																							end
																						end

																						if Parent == t248.Char then
																							return nil
																						end

																						local HumanoidRootPart = Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

																						if not HumanoidRootPart then
																							return nil
																						end

																						if n896 < t251.GetMagnitude(t248.Root, HumanoidRootPart) then
																							return nil
																						end

																						if t251.GetMagnitude(Instance_, HumanoidRootPart) > 10 then
																							return nil
																						end

																						return Parent

																					if not t248.Root then

																						return nil
																					end

																					local Position = t248.Cam.CFrame.Position
																					local LookVector = t248.Cam.CFrame.LookVector
																					local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

																					raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
																						t248.Char,
																						workspace.Terrain
																					}
																					raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

																					local hit = workspace:Raycast(Position, LookVector * 1000, raycastParams) or workspace:Raycast(Position, (LookVector - Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)).Unit * 1000, raycastParams) or workspace:Raycast(Position, (LookVector + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)).Unit * 1000, raycastParams)

																					if not hit then
																						return nil
																					end

																					local Instance_ = hit.Instance
																					local Parent = Instance_.Parent

																					if Parent and Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
																						if Parent.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
																							return nil
																						end
																					else
																						Parent = Instance_:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")

																						if not Parent or not Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or Parent.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
																							return nil
																						end
																					end

																					if Parent == t248.Char then
																						return nil
																					end

																					local HumanoidRootPart = Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

																					if not HumanoidRootPart then
																						return nil
																					end

																					if n924 < t251.GetMagnitude(t248.Root, HumanoidRootPart) then
																						return nil
																					end

																					if t251.GetMagnitude(Instance_, HumanoidRootPart) > 10 then
																						return nil
																					end

																					return Parent
																				end

																local n1396 = 0

																if t248.Root and v14103 and v14103.Position.Y < 2000 then
																	local Position = v14103.Position
																	local CFrame_ = t248.Root.CFrame

																	task.spawn(function()
																		if t248.Char then
																			for _, v in t248.Char:GetChildren() do
																				if v:IsA("BasePart") then
																					v.CanCollide = false
																				end
																			end
																		end
																	end)

																	while true do
																		if n1396 < 50 and v14104 and v14104:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead and v14103.Position.Y < 2000 then
																			if not workspace:FindFirstChild(p2702.Name) or v14105:FindFirstChild("PartOwner") ~= nil and (not v14105:FindFirstChild("PartOwner") or v14105.PartOwner.Value == LocalPlayer.Name) then
																				break
																			end

																			t248.Root.CFrame = v14103.CFrame + (v14103.Position - Position) * LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 100
																			t248.Root.Velocity = t247.VectorZero
																			task.spawn(t251.SNO, v14103)

																			if SoundPart then
																				firetouchinterest(SoundPart, v14103, 0)
																			end

																			task.wait()

																			if not v14105 or not v14105:FindFirstChild("PartOwner") or v14105.PartOwner.Value ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
																				n1396 += 1

																				continue
																			end

																			task.spawn(t251.SNO, v14103)
																			v14104:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
																			task.wait()
																			t249.DestroyLineEvent:FireServer(v14103)
																			t248.Root.CFrame = CFrame_
																			t248.Root.Velocity = t247.VectorZero
																			task.wait()

																			break

																			if not t248.Root then

																			if workspace:FindFirstChild("GrabParts") then
																				return nil
																			end

																			local Position = t248.Cam.CFrame.Position
																			local LookVector = t248.Cam.CFrame.LookVector
																			local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

																			raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
																				t248.Char,
																				workspace.Terrain
																			}
																			raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

																			local hit = workspace:Raycast(Position, LookVector * 1000, raycastParams) or workspace:Raycast(Position, (LookVector - Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)).Unit * 1000, raycastParams) or workspace:Raycast(Position, (LookVector + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)).Unit * 1000, raycastParams)

																			if not hit then
																				return nil
																			end

																			local Instance_ = hit.Instance
																			local Parent = Instance_.Parent

																			if Parent and Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
																				if Parent.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
																					return nil
																				end
																			else
																				Parent = Instance_:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")

																				if not Parent or not Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or Parent.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
																					return nil
																				end
																			end

																			if Parent == t248.Char then
																				return nil
																			end

																			local HumanoidRootPart = Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

																			if not HumanoidRootPart then
																				return nil
																			end

																			if n1408 < t251.GetMagnitude(t248.Root, HumanoidRootPart) then
																				return nil
																			end

																			if t251.GetMagnitude(Instance_, HumanoidRootPart) > 10 then
																				return nil
																			end

																			return Parent
																		end
